name: Enfer Cube
desc: A cube containing an ancient, horrifying monster. While the exact identity of the creature contained within is unknown, breaking the seal to sate one's curiosity is extremely ill-advised.

eff.name: All Stats Down
eff.desc1: Reduces target's ATK, DEF, and SPD by [Lv. x 5]%.

eff.name: Negative Effect Resistance Down
eff.desc1: Lowers target's Negative Effect resistance by [Lv. x 5]%.

eff.name: Critical Rate Down
eff.desc1: Reduces target's critical rate by [Lv. x 10]%.
